commit_title: DEBUG: the audio ISR's worst cases by stage, the fx stage's parts, flash holes

Current Felucca audio.c/console.c expose whole-render maxima and lateness but no stage windows or flash-hole counters. #94 owns bounded stage/resource instrumentation and coherent snapshot/reset semantics, with #56 collector and #46 workload ownership; PR #85 is a collector delivery, not a separate instrumentation issue. The initial helper targets the wrong PLL and runs while XIP is active; later commits correct it. No native bug or beneficial default feature is established. #44 keeps CPU1 experimental and expressly excludes incidental clock/voltage adjustment; device-dependent retuning remains a separately justified experiment.

commit_title: PEAK (SysEx 78): the worst cases in a command of their own

Native Felucca uses CDC status/dbg and lacks ChoralRoot DEBUG/PEAK, so this count overflow is not a native bug. #94/#56 already own instrumentation and schema work. Record the capacity/compatibility lesson there while preserving Felucca wire IDs and coherent interval snapshots.

Felucca does not retune clocks or start CPU1, so it has no affected prior PLL/XIP path. Retain this correction for any separately authorized clock experiment; no native bug or acceleration issue is established.

rationale: Inspected the per-part send ownership, picker key ownership, session tags and removal of forced saves during tails. Native send/picker contracts differ intentionally and are not imported. Reuse that issue; do not import POSIX loader/build/compiler assumptions or claim host/target performance from source.

commit_title: feat: initial gate module - noise gate and downward expander
rationale: Initial ARM64 Gate/Expand plugin uses stereo peak following, hysteresis, attack/hold/release and float/log/exp arithmetic to attenuate low-level material. Native Felucca is a synthesizer without the external audio-input chain this plugin targets (#78 is prospective), and per-voice envelopes plus existing silent-bus work already own release/inactivity behavior. A master noise gate would alter intentional soft notes and FX tails, not provide a sound-preserving resource optimization. No demonstrated native noise-gating need or matching bug justifies a new issue; plugin loader/release metadata is platform-specific.
